title: Tensor-product presentation of an affine piece at all stages and the limit
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine transitions [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and $c$ a limiting cone [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $i_0\le k$. Let $X_0,Y_0$ be schemes over $D(i_0)$ and $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ a morphism over that base [def-pc-fibre-product], locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Assume its base change $f_k$ to $D(k)$ is affine. Let $V\subseteq Y_0$ and $W\subseteq D(i_0)$ be affine opens [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points] with $V\subseteq(Y_0\to D(i_0))^{-1}(W)$. Denote the base changes by $f_i,f$ and their first target projections by $p_{i0},p_0$. Put $J=\{i\in I:k\le i\}$ and $j_*=k\in J$. There exist a diagram $F:J\to\mathrm{CommRing}$, two commutative $F(j_*)$-algebras $B,C$, and a finite type algebra map $\varphi:B\to C$ [lem-weil-pbc-lft-affine-pairs], such that the arrow $f|_{p_0^{-1}(V)}$ is isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}(\mathrm{id}_{\operatorname{colim}F}\otimes\varphi)$ and, for every $j\in J$, the arrow $f_j|_{p_{j0}^{-1}(V)}$ is isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}(\mathrm{id}_{F(j)}\otimes\varphi)$. The algebra structures on $F(j)$ and $\operatorname{colim}F$ are induced by the transition $F(j_*)\to F(j)$ and the colimit inclusion [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Tensor products and Spec have their usual affine fibre-product meaning [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. No finiteness assumption on $f$ is imposed.

source.place: Proof of Tag 01ZO (lemma-descend-finite-finite-presentation), affine reduction; Tags 01YX and 01YW, restriction of limits to opens and Spec of the coordinate-ring colimit. Read also at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01ZO, /01YX, /01YW.

proof.text: The inverse image W_k of W under D(k)→D(i₀) is affine. Apply the affine-open directed-ring-system theorem at index k to obtain F, its initial spectrum isomorphism, each stage spectrum isomorphism and the colimit spectrum isomorphism, with specified structure-map compatibility.

Apply the finite-type single-base-piece tensor comparison to d=D(k)→D(i₀), the initial spectrum model supplied by the preceding step, and the original f₀,V,W. Obtain B,C,aB,aC,φ and its finite-type proof together with the comparison for every compatible further base change.

Instantiate the comparison with the cone leg c→D(k), the colimit ring and the colimit spectrum model. Cone naturality gives c→D(k)→D(i₀)=c→D(i₀). Instantiate again for each stage j≥k using its spectrum model and transition algebra. Functoriality gives D(j)→D(k)→D(i₀)=D(j)→D(i₀). Rewrite these equalities to obtain exactly both arrow-isomorphism clauses.

mathlib_searches.query: Present an affine morphism over a directed inverse limit and every finite stage as Spec of a tensor product map over the coordinate ring colimit
Present base changes of a finite type affine scheme morphism along an inverse limit as spectra of tensor product algebra maps

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_base_piece_tensor_presentation
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ k : I) (hk : i₀ ≤ k)
    (X₀ Y₀ : Over (D.obj (op i₀))) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left]
    (haffine : IsAffineHom (((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE hk).op)).map f₀).left))
    (V : Y₀.left.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (W : (D.obj (op i₀)).Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (hVW : V ≤ Y₀.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    : ∃ (F : {i : I // k ≤ i} ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
      (B C : CommRingCat.{u})
      (aB : F.obj ⟨k, le_rfl⟩ →+* B) (aC : F.obj ⟨k, le_rfl⟩ →+* C),
      letI : Algebra (F.obj ⟨k, le_rfl⟩) B := aB.toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra (F.obj ⟨k, le_rfl⟩) C := aC.toAlgebra
      ∃ φ : B →ₐ[F.obj ⟨k, le_rfl⟩] C, φ.FiniteType ∧
        (letI : Algebra (F.obj ⟨k, le_rfl⟩) (colimit F : CommRingCat.{u}) :=
          (CommRingCat.Hom.hom (colimit.ι F ⟨k, le_rfl⟩)).toAlgebra
        Nonempty
          (Arrow.mk
            ((((Over.pullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).map f₀).left) ∣_
              ((pullback.fst Y₀.hom (c.π.app (op i₀))) ⁻¹ᵁ V)) ≅
            Arrow.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
                (AlgHom.id (F.obj ⟨k, le_rfl⟩) (colimit F : CommRingCat.{u})) φ).toRingHom)))) ∧
        (∀ j : {i : I // k ≤ i},
          letI : Algebra (F.obj ⟨k, le_rfl⟩) (F.obj j) :=
            (CommRingCat.Hom.hom (F.map (homOfLE j.property))).toAlgebra
          Nonempty
            (Arrow.mk
              ((((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE (hk.trans j.property)).op)).map f₀).left)
                ∣_ ((pullback.fst Y₀.hom
                  (D.map (homOfLE (hk.trans j.property)).op)) ⁻¹ᵁ V)) ≅
              Arrow.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
                  (AlgHom.id (F.obj ⟨k, le_rfl⟩) (F.obj j)) φ).toRingHom))))
